text_block_list.text:
The day of Матиканэфукукитару's debut
has
arrived. With the pressure on, she
begins to
crumble.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she is never alone—for she has
the gods
on her side!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Remembering this, she offers her prayers
with the
utmost grace and makes her
way onto the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
